classifications.observed: Existing reference/provenance or values captured from actual execution. Observed does not imply real robot measurement.
classifications.derived: Numerically computed/rendered from observed source and execution records.
classifications.schematic_not_executed: Explicitly unexecuted architecture stage; no fabricated numeric output.

alternative_inputs.role: Alternative single-body reference keyframes and descriptor/text cards; not one concatenated multi-body input.

coordinate_conventions.rot6d: first two matrix columns concatenated; Gram-Schmidt if input is 6D
coordinate_conventions.camera: each projection JSON is exact rendered camera; pixels top-left origin; arrows are projected actual MJCF axis
coordinate_conventions.render_gauge: reference G1 keeps raw root position. H2 predictions use root-relative positions at origin; no hidden floor snap.

UniMate.label: schematic_not_executed
UniMate.model_input_relation: Real standardized/padded motion array computed. Caption/joint-name embeddings, noisy x_tau, denoiser v_theta and ODE rollout were not computed.
UniMate.robot_adaptation: No native G1/Go2/Franka-to-H2 inference established. This is a UniMate native Mixamo text-to-skeleton preprocessing case.

limits: H2 uses fresh descriptor from locally converted MJCF bound to official URDF/meshes; the older anonymous H2 cache is not used.
H2 rotation outputs are unconstrained and converted by Gram-Schmidt and FK. No IK, joint-limit/manifold projection or valid-command guarantee. One ambiguous merged waist_roll_link mesh is omitted.
Root hpos channel0 is supervised ground-clearance height in meters; other raw hpos channels are not metric coordinates. Diagram geometry uses rotation-derived FK.
Panda finger slide joints are not established as supported by the legacy hinge-oriented descriptor.
UniMate has only native Mixamo preprocessing, no neural forward, flow velocity, ODE generation or robot retargeting.
Private weights, raw source motions, and full geometry source assets remain remote; local files are derived presentation material, traces and reproduction code.
Downloading resources and passing software checks are distinct from training, simulation and physical validation.

remote_only_references.label: derived
remote_only_references.units: canonical body units; standardized arrays dimensionless
remote_only_references.reason: Contains original selected source pose/quaternion arrays; computed model_inputs_derived.npz is the delivered export.
